headline: Central Fronts Reignite as Fierce Clashes Sweep Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the brief lull across the interior has broken as violent clashes returned to the central line, while eastern sectors in Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts fell entirely quiet with zero base transfers over the last two hours. Weathered Expanse surged to the forefront of the conflict, logging five base events in the two-hour span alongside nearly eighteen hundred combined casualties, leaving one base unoccupied in no-man's-land. Linn of Mercy and Dead Lands similarly reignited, posting two and three base exchanges respectively under heavy shelling, with Dead Lands exacting over a thousand Warden casualties in the latest interval. Callahan's Passage and Marban Hollow also saw sharp spikes in movement, recording two and three events each as fighting centered on contested positions at The Latch and Mox. Stonecradle and Farranac Coast continue to endure sustained casualty rates without immediate territorial changes, while peripheral island and rearward territories remain static.
